declarations.description:
A row whose content slides sideways to reveal actions behind it, as in a mail or task list on a phone: drag the row
toward the end edge to show the `start` actions, toward the start edge to show the `end` actions. Release past
halfway (or flick) and the row stays open; release short and it slides back. A tap on the open row, a press outside
it, Escape, or activating one of its actions closes it again.

Put `c2-button`s (or any focusable element) in the `start` and `end` slots; they sit centred at their own height, or
fill the row with `--c2-swipe-action__actions--align-items: stretch`. The
actions stay in the Tab order and in the accessibility tree while hidden, and focusing one opens its side, so the
row works without a pointer. Only one side can be open; vertical drags are left to the page so a list still scrolls.

With `full-swipe`, dragging past 60% of the row's width arms the outermost action of that side (the first `start`
action, the last `end` action), which grows to fill the row; releasing there fires a cancelable `full-swipe` event
and then clicks that action, so its own handler runs — the "swipe all the way to delete" gesture.

The content needs an opaque background to cover the actions at rest: `--c2-swipe-action__content--background`.
Directions follow `dir`: in right-to-left the `start` actions sit on the right.
declarations.name: SwipeAction

cssProperties.description: Shown behind the actions where they do not fill the revealed area.
cssProperties.name: --c2-swipe-action__container--background

cssProperties.description: Must be opaque: it covers the actions while the row is closed.
cssProperties.name: --c2-swipe-action__content--background

cssProperties.description: Shadow under the content while it is moved, which lifts it off the actions.
cssProperties.name: --c2-swipe-action__content__open--box-shadow

cssProperties.description: How long the row takes to settle after a release or an `open` change.
cssProperties.name: --c2-swipe-action__content--transition-duration

cssProperties.description: Space between the actions of one side.
cssProperties.name: --c2-swipe-action__actions--gap

cssProperties.description: Room around the actions of each side. `0` with `--c2-swipe-action__actions--align-items: stretch` makes full-bleed action blocks.
cssProperties.name: --c2-swipe-action__actions--padding

cssProperties.description: `center` keeps buttons at their own height; `stretch` makes them as tall as the row.
cssProperties.name: --c2-swipe-action__actions--align-items

cssParts.description: The sliding box around the default slot.
cssParts.name: content

cssParts.description: The box that holds the `start` actions.
cssParts.name: start

cssParts.description: The box that holds the `end` actions.
cssParts.name: end

slots.description: Actions revealed at the start edge (the left in left-to-right) by dragging the row toward the end edge.
slots.name: start

slots.description: Actions revealed at the end edge (the right in left-to-right) by dragging the row toward the start edge.
slots.name: end

members.name: open
members.description: The side whose actions are shown: `start`, `end`, or `''` for closed. Swiping, tapping and focus change it.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Stops the row from moving. An open row closes.

members.name: fullSwipe
members.description: Lets a long swipe, past 60% of the row's width, trigger the outermost action of that side on release.

members.name: dragOffset
members.description: The offset of the content while a finger or mouse drags it, in logical pixels (positive reveals `start`).

members.name: widths
members.description: The natural widths of the two action boxes, measured while they are not stretched.

type.text:
{
    pointerId: number
    startX: number
    startY: number
    base: number
    dragging: boolean
    lastX: number
    lastTime: number
    velocity: number
  } | undefined

members.name: swallowClick
members.description: Set after a drag or a tap that closed the row, so the click that follows does not reach the content.

members.name: close
members.description: Slides the content back over the actions.

members.name: measure
members.description: Reads the natural widths of the action boxes. A stretched box (mid full-swipe) keeps its last reading.

members.name: direction
members.description: `-1` in right-to-left. Read with the widths, on the client only, so a server render assumes left-to-right.

members.name: restOffset
members.description: The resting offset for the current `open`, in logical pixels.

members.name: constrain
members.description: Clamps a raw drag to the sides that have actions, and resists past their width unless a full swipe is allowed.

members.name: settle
members.description: Where a released drag comes to rest: the direction of a flick, else past halfway opens.

members.name: actionElement
members.description: The element to click for a slotted action, looking through `display: contents` wrappers (an Astro island, a framework's).

members.name: handleActionClick
members.description: Activating an action closes the row, after the action's own click handlers have run.

members.name: handleFocusIn
members.description: Focus moving onto an action shows its side, so the hidden actions are usable from the keyboard.

events.name: open-change
events.description: A swipe, tap, Escape, focus or an action opened or closed the row. `detail.open` is the side now open, or `''`. Not fired when `open` is set from code. Does not bubble.

events.name: full-swipe
events.description: A full swipe was released (with `full-swipe` set). Cancel it to keep the outermost action from being clicked; the row closes either way. Does not bubble.

attributes.name: open
